meta.name: parrot
meta.author: kakak-animation
meta.description: An African grey parrot rigged from one illustration: head turn, tilt, nod and bob, blink and gaze, a beak that opens, a wing that lifts, a red tail with physics, breathing, lean, bounce and hops.

parameters.description: Head turn: > 0 toward the screen right (more profile)
Head nod: > 0 looks up (the beak rises)
Head tilt about the neck, clockwise for > 0 (the curious tilt)
Head bob forward (> 0) and back, 8 px
Head bob up (> 0) and down, 6 px
Blink: 0 = closed (the visible eye is the left one)
Lower mandible: 0 closed, 0.3 as drawn (the smile), 1 wide open
Lean toward the screen right (> 0), about the feet
Inhale: the chest widens, the upper body rises
Knee bounce: > 0 crouch and squash, < 0 stretch up
Jump: the whole bird rises 24 px
Raise the wing about the shoulder (34 deg at 1)
Physics output: the wing lags behind body motion
Physics output: the tail lags behind body motion

warps.description: Root lattice over the whole canvas: one continuous mesh for head, neck, body and legs. Head turn / tilt / nod / bob, lean, bounce, breath and hop are additive offset fields on it; the toes stay planted.
The wing, raised about the shoulder by WingFlap and WingSway.
The red tail, swung about its root by TailWag and TailSway.
The lower mandible, opened about the corner of the beak by MouthOpen.

parts.description: Red tail feathers; the root under the wing and the leg is painted in, so a swing shows no gap.
The whole bird except the tail, wing, mandible and pupil; the body behind the wing, the chin behind the mandible and the eye ring behind the pupil are painted in.
The head above the neck line again, over the wing: a lowered head covers the top of the wing. Same lattice as base, so it never separates from it.
Inside of the beak; its lower edge rides on the mandible (MouthOpen).
Upper beak with the nostril, over the mandible so a closing beak tucks under the hook.
Mask of the pupil (never drawn): the lids. Closes to a curved sliver, which leaves the dark closed-eye line.
Pupil with its highlight (a hole that shows the eye ring); clipped by eyeOpening.

bindings.description: Head tilt about the neck pivot, 18 deg at +-30; fades out over the neck.
Pseudo-3D head turn: yaw 7 deg on a sphere; the beak rides on the face.
Look up / down: 6 deg about the neck plus a 4 px slide of the face.
Lean of everything above the knees about the feet, 3 deg at +-10.
Knee bounce: crouch 7 px and squash 3.5 %, or stretch; the head rides rigidly.
Breathing: the chest widens 2 %, the upper body rises 1.6 px.
Wing raised about the shoulder (clockwise lifts the tip up and back).
Physics lag of the wing, 5 deg.
Tail swing about its root, 14 deg.
Physics lag of the tail, 10 deg.
Lower mandible about the corner of the beak: -15 deg closed, 24 deg wide open.
Inside of the beak follows the mandible (same keyforms, so it stays glued to it).
Lids close to a curved sliver.

physics.description: The tail lags behind leaning and head bobbing.
The folded wing lags a little behind leaning and bouncing.

animations.description: Breathing, a slow lean, small head turns and tilts, a glance, a beak click and two blinks. Seamless loop; layer talk or blink on top.
One blink; play it with "once" over another animation.
Chatter: the beak opens and closes with small nods. Keys sit around the defaults, so it also plays as an "add" layer over idle.

Head-bobbing dance at 120 bpm: the head snaps forward and down on every beat while the knees bounce, the body sways over two beats each way, the tail wags, the wing pops on beats 2 and 4 and the beak chirps on 1 and 3.
The curious parrot: tilts its head back to look up, blinks, then tilts the other way and leans in to peer down, double-blinks and comes back.
Excited squawk: a crouch, a hop with the wing fluttering, the beak wide open and the head thrown back, a landing squash, then calm breathing.
